_comment: Expected dimension ranges for engine.Compute(template=classic, format=png) against the mocked octocat GraphQL fixture. The values are an envelope, not a target — width_min guards the 480px canvas width (SC-001); the height bounds catch a 1x1 placeholder leaking through (lower) and accidental layout explosions (upper). classic renders base-only since #463, so the card is ~200-290px tall, matching upstream metrics.classic.svg (height 203-223).
